mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing fair conditions with a temperature of 70 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park.

The Public Works Department reminds residents they are busy maintaining city streets and utilities, while the city also invites everyone to sign up for their digital newsletter to track upcoming development projects like the Ardent Glen plat.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee, plus check back tomorrow for events like Hop Haus trivia and ART House 360.
In a noteworthy incident on October 3, a 19-year-old was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm following a traffic stop for expired registration.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Turtle Cheesecake, and you can satisfy your craving when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
